title: Micron says 700-plus Taiwan fab workers earned five years' salary in a single year
content: Micron Technology paid its fiscal 2026 bonuses to Taiwan employees on October 30. The company said more than 700 production-line workers earned at least five years' worth of monthly salary in total pay for the year. The payout comes while the union at its Taoyuan fab is still rejecting the company's pay offer.

title: Realtek targets 30% AI revenue share by 2030
content: Realtek Semiconductor quantified its AI business for the first time at an investor conference on October 29, setting a target for high-performance computing (HPC) and edge AI revenue—including automotive and robotics applications—to exceed 30% of total revenue by 2030. These businesses currently account for a high-single-digit percentage of revenue, as AI expands into infrastructure and edge devices.

title: Holtek lands major server cooling contract, AI thermal demand soars
content: Microcontroller unit (MCU) major Holtek Semiconductor has secured a substantial order for brushless DC (BLDC) motors, with adoption in Taiwanese server cooling fans slated to begin in 2027, paving the way for steep year-over-year growth. In addition, the company's optical communication products, specifically storage area network (SAN) disk arrays tailored for AI servers, are scheduled to enter mass production in the first quarter of 2027.

Although the event featured slightly fewer robots than in 2025, it still maintained a dedicated robotics exhibition area where Foxconn and its partners showcased the latest developments in smart manufacturing technology. title: Eutelsat eyes EUR10B revenue from IRIS2 as EU seeks homegrown answer to Starlink
content: Eutelsat said that it predicts at least EUR10 billion (US$11.2 billion) in revenue from 2032 to 2040 as it leads the EU's low Earth orbit (LEO) network initiative IRIS2. The European satellite player is viewed by the EU to be a homegrown alternative to SpaceX's Starlink satellite service and a key to reducing technological reliance on the US.

title: C Sun Mfg invests in Nemstek to expand advanced packaging equipment
content: C Sun Mfg announced on October 30 that it would subscribe for 1,900 lots of Nemstek's privately placed common shares as a strategic investor, giving it an expected stake of approximately 4.68% upon completion. The investment is intended to combine the companies' plasma treatment, thermal processing and automation capabilities as advanced packaging moves toward higher-density integration.

title: SK Hynix taps HBM veteran to lead new American unit
content: SK Hynix has appointed its AI memory development chief to lead a newly established Americas unit based in the US, putting a technology veteran closer to major US customers as the industry shifts toward customized high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and deeper collaboration with chip developers.

title: Google, Foxconn aims to cut AI infrastructure deployment to six months
content: Google is deepening its strategic partnership with Foxconn to accelerate AI infrastructure deployment, aiming to cut the time from chip supply to data-center deployment from the traditional 12 to 18 months to about six months, said Rehan Sheikh, vice president of global silicon chip technology and manufacturing at Google Cloud, at Hon Hai Tech Day (HHTD 26) on October 30.

title: Foxconn, TECO showcase factory-built infrastructure for AI data center expansion
content: Hon Hai (Foxconn) and TECO Electric & Machinery showcased a jointly developed modular data center at Hon Hai Tech Day 2026, highlighting a factory-built approach to AI infrastructure. The 40-foot container integrates computing, cooling, power, energy management, and fire protection systems, as the companies target rising global demand for AI computing capacity.

title: Foxconn argues it is more than a box mover in AI hardware
content: Foxconn chairman Young Liu said the company's core strengths are processing capabilities and vertical integration, as the manufacturer seeks to move beyond its long-standing image as a simple "Box Mover." At its 2026 Hon Hai Tech Day, Liu described an end-to-end model spanning design, components, assembly, software integration, and global logistics.

title: China's memory module bellwethers post record profits as 3Q26 momentum fades
content: China's listed memory module makers, whose results offer an early read on how the global memory upcycle is reaching the country's storage supply chain, reported net profit gains of more than 300-fold at the top end for the first nine months of 2026. Yet several of the largest players also posted sharp sequential profit declines in the third quarter, suggesting the windfall from low-cost inventory meeting surging contract prices is narrowing.

title: Samsung SDI posts 12-quarter high in 3Q26 operating profit
content: Samsung SDI, a major South Korean battery maker, posted strong results in the third quarter of 2026 as rising energy storage system (ESS) battery demand lifted operating profit to its highest level in 12 quarters. The company is also expanding into emerging applications, advancing the commercialization of all-solid-state batteries and securing new cylindrical battery customers in aerospace and humanoid robotics.

title: Nvidia secures substrate capacity as FCBGA market targets US$27.3 billion by 2030
content: Nvidia has begun securing advanced substrate capacity in Taiwan, Japan and South Korea, using capacity reservation agreements and upfront payments to support supplier expansion as next-generation AI accelerators ramp up. The move comes as the global packaging substrate market is projected to grow from US$14.9 billion in 2025 to US$40.2 billion in 2030, while demand for advanced ABF build-up materials is expected to exceed supply from 2027.
